classification.difficultyReason: Find two different triangular-face heights using Pythagoras, then combine the four triangular faces and rectangular base.

content.prompt: In the diagram, $VABCD$ is a rectangular pyramid. If $VO=6\text{ cm}$ is the height of the pyramid, $CD=10\text{ cm}$ and $BC=8\text{ cm}$, find the following. Give exact answers and decimal approximations to 3 decimal places.

spec.description: Unshaded rectangular pyramid with V vertically above the intersection O of base diagonals AC and DB. D and C are the front vertices, A and B the rear vertices. Preserve base right-angle cues, dashed hidden edges, highlighted construction lines and the external height dimension.
spec.mathematics: ABCD is a rectangle, CD=10 cm, BC=8 cm, O is its centre and VO=6 cm is perpendicular to the base. Visible solid edges are VD, VC, VB, DC and CB; hidden edges are VA, AD and AB.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied dimensions, vertex labels and construction lines are shown; neither triangular-face height is supplied.

answer.worked:
Let $M$ be the midpoint of $BC$. Since $O$ is the centre of the rectangle, $OM=\frac{10}{2}=5\text{ cm}$. The face height is $VM$.
$$\begin{align*}VM^2&=VO^2+OM^2\\VM^2&=6^2+5^2\\VM^2&=61\\VM&=\sqrt{61}\text{ cm}\approx7.810\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$

Let $N$ be the midpoint of $DC$. Since $O$ is the centre of the rectangle, $ON=\frac{8}{2}=4\text{ cm}$. The face height is $VN$.
$$\begin{align*}VN^2&=VO^2+ON^2\\VN^2&=6^2+4^2\\VN^2&=52\\VN&=2\sqrt{13}\text{ cm}\approx7.211\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: The surface area of the pyramid.

answer.short:
$(80+8\sqrt{61}+20\sqrt{13})\text{ cm}^2\approx214.593\text{ cm}^2$.

Add the rectangular base and two pairs of congruent triangular faces.
answer.worked:
Opposite triangular faces have equal areas. Use the exact face heights from parts a and b.
$$\begin{align*}A_{VBC}&=\frac12\times8\times\sqrt{61}=4\sqrt{61}\text{ cm}^2\\A_{VDC}&=\frac12\times10\times2\sqrt{13}=10\sqrt{13}\text{ cm}^2\\A_{\text{base}}&=10\times8=80\text{ cm}^2\\A_{\text{surface}}&=80+2(4\sqrt{61})+2(10\sqrt{13})\\A_{\text{surface}}&=80+8\sqrt{61}+20\sqrt{13}\text{ cm}^2\\A_{\text{surface}}&\approx214.593\text{ cm}^2.\end{align*}$$
